verdicts.reason: Both lose the original's main feature, the diamond photo mosaic. It shrinks to one small rectangular crop, and an empty grid of white outline diamonds plus a stray divider line hang in the top right as broken leftovers. The body copy is tiny and set apart from the headline, and the vertical URL floats on its own. A spaces the date diamond evenly away from the photo. In B the date diamond almost touches the photo edge, which looks cramped, though B's body copy sits slightly closer to the headline.
